verdict.rationale: doola is a company-formation and compliance service with a Partner API, an embedded SDK and an MCP server. It is not a platform where users write and manage their own automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. Nearby features such as sandbox testing, idempotent retries and Pulse bookkeeping automation are different capabilities and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
